evals.prompt: Add a shared schema for a save profile input in @pumni/validators: fields are displayName (non-empty string min 1 max 80), bio (optional, max 200, empty string coerced to null), and website (optional URL). Export the schema and its inferred input type so the form and Server Action share one shape.
evals.expected_output: A feature file packages/validators/src/profile.ts exporting a profileSchema using Zod 4 top-level format validators (z.url() for website) and an inferred type export (ProfileInput = z.infer<typeof profileSchema>), re-exported from src/index.ts, with no db/auth/env/app-alias dependencies.
expectations: The schema lives in packages/validators/src/profile.ts and is re-exported from src/index.ts
The website field uses a Zod 4 top-level format validator such as z.url() rather than z.string().url()
The schema and its inferred input type are both exported (export type ProfileInput = z.infer<typeof profileSchema>)
The bio field handles empty-string-by-coercing-to-null or uses .optional() appropriately
The file contains no server-only imports, no @/ app aliases, and no database/auth/env access
The file has no authorization logic embedded in the schema

evals.prompt: I need my profile schema to refuse submission when the user is not an admin. Add a z.refine to profileSchema that checks the user role server-side and rejects if they are not an admin, importing the auth helper from @/lib/auth.
evals.expected_output: The response rejects embedding authorization logic (admin role check) in the Zod schema and importing a server-side auth helper via an app alias, because schemas must be pure and framework-agnostic and auth belongs in the Server Action / RLS, not the schema.
expectations: The response refuses to add z.refine auth/admin checks to the shared schema
The response refuses to import @/lib/auth or any server-only/auth module into the validator
The response states that schemas must be pure, side-effect free, and cross the client/server boundary cleanly
The response directs authorization to the Server Action (requireUser) or RLS owners
No @/ app alias is introduced in packages/validators

evals.prompt: Our profileSchema displayName is currently minLength 1 but the form sometimes sends an empty string for optional name. Update the schema so an empty displayName is treated as invalid with a clear message, without importing anything from the app or server.
evals.expected_output: A schema change that keeps displayName required with a clear min(1) message (or refines empty strings to an explicit error), still exports the inferred type, and introduces no app/server/auth/env imports - pure Zod only.
expectations: displayName stays required with a clear min(1) validation message (empty string rejected, not silently accepted)
No app alias (@/), server-only, env, auth, or database imports are added to the schema
The inferred input type is still exported
The schema remains side-effect free and deterministic
If the inferred type changed, the response notes that consumers (form, action, tests) must update in the same change
